<docTitle>
<text>《别想太多啦》（日本畅销40万册的情绪疗愈指南！听日本超人气“傻和尚”讲讲生活禅，在复杂的世界里，做一个简单的人）</text>
</docTitle>
<navMap>
    <navPoint id="np_1" playOrder="1">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第一章：练习钝感力</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#aid-2RHM1"/>
      <navPoint id="np_2" playOrder="2">
      <navLabel>
      <text>只要不作恶，你就是个好人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_1"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_3" playOrder="3">
      <navLabel>
      <text>人生是教给我“适度”的老师</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_2"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_4" playOrder="4">
      <navLabel>
      <text>别人如何看自己是“对方的问题”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_3"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_5" playOrder="5">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要在意“大家都这么说”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_4"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_6" playOrder="6">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不说坏话，不听恶语</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_5"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_7" playOrder="7">
      <navLabel>
      <text>帮忙和善心，完成就好</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_6"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_8" playOrder="8">
      <navLabel>
      <text>早发生摩擦是一件好事</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_7"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_9" playOrder="9">
      <navLabel>
      <text>我常常被称为“傻瓜”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_8"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_10" playOrder="10">
      <navLabel>
      <text>即使失败了，又能怎样</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_9"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_11" playOrder="11">
      <navLabel>
      <text>“自然体”的人，获得的结果最理想</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_10"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_12" playOrder="12">
      <navLabel>
      <text>忍耐分为两种</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_11"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_13" playOrder="13">
      <navLabel>
      <text>一句“原来如此”，就能让人轻松许多</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_12"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_14" playOrder="14">
      <navLabel>
      <text>退一步，并不难</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_13"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_15" playOrder="15">
      <navLabel>
      <text>对于别人的唠叨，说“谢谢你的好意”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_14"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_16" playOrder="16">
      <navLabel>
      <text>赋予何种意义在于自己</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_15"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_17" playOrder="17">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不知道就坦言“不知道”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_16"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_18" playOrder="18">
      <navLabel>
      <text>世间之事未必按你的想法发展</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0003.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_17"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint id="np_19" playOrder="19">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第二章：你想太多了</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#aid-3Q281"/>
      <navPoint id="np_20" playOrder="20">
      <navLabel>
      <text>人生没有胜负</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_18"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_21" playOrder="21">
      <navLabel>
      <text>为什么想被赞美</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_19"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_22" playOrder="22">
      <navLabel>
      <text>“请理解我”的愿望会缩小自己的气量</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_20"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_23" playOrder="23">
      <navLabel>
      <text>幸福并非拥有什么，关键要认清幸福</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_21"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_24" playOrder="24">
      <navLabel>
      <text>遭遇“背叛”并不稀奇</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_22"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_25" playOrder="25">
      <navLabel>
      <text>与他人比较，若自己高兴会伤人，若悲伤会失去自我</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_23"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_26" playOrder="26">
      <navLabel>
      <text>别人抢功劳，也不会影响你的价值</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_24"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_27" playOrder="27">
      <navLabel>
      <text>想为别人做点什么是很伟大的</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_25"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_28" playOrder="28">
      <navLabel>
      <text>世间大部分人既非敌人，亦非朋友</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_26"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_29" playOrder="29">
      <navLabel>
      <text>“别人是别人，自己是自己”的思维陷阱</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_27"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_30" playOrder="30">
      <navLabel>
      <text>试着从“不拥有”中获得乐趣</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_28"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_31" playOrder="31">
      <navLabel>
      <text>有余力的时候，就去帮别人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_29"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_32" playOrder="32">
      <navLabel>
      <text>你忙的时候，大家也很忙</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_30"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_33" playOrder="33">
      <navLabel>
      <text>做好事，不必让别人知道</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_31"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_34" playOrder="34">
      <navLabel>
      <text>丢东西之前，先丢掉执念</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_32"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_35" playOrder="35">
      <navLabel>
      <text>离别的时刻一定会到来</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_33"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_36" playOrder="36">
      <navLabel>
      <text>你我都拥有无限的可能</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_34"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_37" playOrder="37">
      <navLabel>
      <text>试着远离大道理</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_35"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_38" playOrder="38">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要戴着有色眼镜看人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0004.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_36"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint id="np_39" playOrder="39">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第三章：心情忧郁时这么想</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#aid-4OIQ1"/>
      <navPoint id="np_40" playOrder="40">
      <navLabel>
      <text>经历多次失败后，更能理解他人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_37"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_41" playOrder="41">
      <navLabel>
      <text>负面情绪任它来，任它去</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_38"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_42" playOrder="42">
      <navLabel>
      <text>你可以让别人失望</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_39"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_43" playOrder="43">
      <navLabel>
      <text>如何减少负能量</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_40"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_44" playOrder="44">
      <navLabel>
      <text>身老，心不老</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_41"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_45" playOrder="45">
      <navLabel>
      <text>成为料理人生的高手</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_42"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_46" playOrder="46">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要说心里没有的事</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_43"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_47" playOrder="47">
      <navLabel>
      <text>顺境也好，逆境也好</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_44"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_48" playOrder="48">
      <navLabel>
      <text>“迟钝、慢性子、笨拙”不行吗</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_45"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_49" playOrder="49">
      <navLabel>
      <text>别人批评你时，可以这样想</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_46"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_50" playOrder="50">
      <navLabel>
      <text>没有必要急于改变自己</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_47"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_51" playOrder="51">
      <navLabel>
      <text>用小欲之锄和知足之锹耕种心田</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_48"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_52" playOrder="52">
      <navLabel>
      <text>遇事绝不可为难自己</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_49"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_53" playOrder="53">
      <navLabel>
      <text>孤独是好的，但不可以孤立</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_50"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_54" playOrder="54">
      <navLabel>
      <text>要意识到一个人的力量有限</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_51"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_55" playOrder="55">
      <navLabel>
      <text>机遇伴随危机而来</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_52"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_56" playOrder="56">
      <navLabel>
      <text>现在的你就很好</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0005.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_53"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint id="np_57" playOrder="57">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第四章：不比较、不苛责、不拖延</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#aid-5N3C1"/>
      <navPoint id="np_58" playOrder="58">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不是“你不如人”，而是还有改进的空间</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_54"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_59" playOrder="59">
      <navLabel>
      <text>世间存在四种人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_55"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_60" playOrder="60">
      <navLabel>
      <text>麻烦是相互的</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_56"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_61" playOrder="61">
      <navLabel>
      <text>执着于得失，反而损失更多</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_57"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_62" playOrder="62">
      <navLabel>
      <text>被别人讨厌，你的感受如何</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_58"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_63" playOrder="63">
      <navLabel>
      <text>在意别人的眼光前应该做的事</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_59"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_64" playOrder="64">
      <navLabel>
      <text>每个人都习惯以自我为中心</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_60"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_65" playOrder="65">
      <navLabel>
      <text>“无所事事”的日子才是最棒的</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_61"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_66" playOrder="66">
      <navLabel>
      <text>你能为别人的成功喝彩吗</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_62"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_67" playOrder="67">
      <navLabel>
      <text>找到生气的开关</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_63"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_68" playOrder="68">
      <navLabel>
      <text>如果遇到令你羡慕的人</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_64"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_69" playOrder="69">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要想“这是我的东西”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_65"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_70" playOrder="70">
      <navLabel>
      <text>嫉妒是因为“现在的自己不幸福”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_66"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_71" playOrder="71">
      <navLabel>
      <text>争吵其实毫无意义</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_67"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_72" playOrder="72">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要自满和自夸</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_68"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_73" playOrder="73">
      <navLabel>
      <text>人生顺利的秘诀不是金钱，而是人格</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0006.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_69"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint id="np_74" playOrder="74">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第五章：让人生变简单的秘诀</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#aid-6LJU1"/>
      <navPoint id="np_75" playOrder="75">
      <navLabel>
      <text>与人交流依靠感觉，而非思考</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_70"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_76" playOrder="76">
      <navLabel>
      <text>说话的基本是诚实</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_71"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_77" playOrder="77">
      <navLabel>
      <text>表达意见时，注意表达的顺序</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_72"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_78" playOrder="78">
      <navLabel>
      <text>夜晚，请安静地度过</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_73"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_79" playOrder="79">
      <navLabel>
      <text>减少好恶感的秘诀</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_74"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_80" playOrder="80">
      <navLabel>
      <text>用心生活，需要锻炼爱的能力</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_75"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_81" playOrder="81">
      <navLabel>
      <text>了解“对金钱没有安全感”的本质</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_76"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_82" playOrder="82">
      <navLabel>
      <text>面对信息，不要“暴饮暴食”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_77"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_83" playOrder="83">
      <navLabel>
      <text>帮不上大忙，小小的支援也很好</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_78"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_84" playOrder="84">
      <navLabel>
      <text>遇到难相处的人，保持内心的距离</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_79"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_85" playOrder="85">
      <navLabel>
      <text>电话、微信、社交网站只是沟通工具</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_80"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_86" playOrder="86">
      <navLabel>
      <text>少说“可是、不过、然而”这些否定表达</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_81"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_87" playOrder="87">
      <navLabel>
      <text>处理感情和表情的方式</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_82"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_88" playOrder="88">
      <navLabel>
      <text>简朴的生活更轻松自在</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_83"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_89" playOrder="89">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要承诺自己做不到的事</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_84"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_90" playOrder="90">
      <navLabel>
      <text>无须非要分出是非黑白</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_85"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_91" playOrder="91">
      <navLabel>
      <text>换个说法，就能改变人际关系</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_86"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_92" playOrder="92">
      <navLabel>
      <text>来自“失恋名人”的劝告</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0007.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_87"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint id="np_93" playOrder="93">
    <navLabel>
    <text>第六章：好好活在此时、此地</text>
    </navLabel>
    <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#aid-7K4G1"/>
      <navPoint id="np_94" playOrder="94">
      <navLabel>
      <text>现在的选择影响未来的生活</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_88"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_95" playOrder="95">
      <navLabel>
      <text>没有一天是白白度过的</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_89"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_96" playOrder="96">
      <navLabel>
      <text>闷闷不乐也不会改变结果</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_90"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_97" playOrder="97">
      <navLabel>
      <text>轮到你上场的那天总会到来</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_91"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_98" playOrder="98">
      <navLabel>
      <text>探寻乐趣与好东西</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_92"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_99" playOrder="99">
      <navLabel>
      <text>成为一只“成熟”的变色龙</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_93"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_100" playOrder="100">
      <navLabel>
      <text>赶流行不是坏事，只是……</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_94"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_101" playOrder="101">
      <navLabel>
      <text>夫妻和睦的秘诀在于“共同经历”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_95"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_102" playOrder="102">
      <navLabel>
      <text>早点发现“上了年纪”的好处</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_96"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_103" playOrder="103">
      <navLabel>
      <text>做自己认为对的事情</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_97"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_104" playOrder="104">
      <navLabel>
      <text>人生的“预防医学”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_98"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_105" playOrder="105">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不管好事还是坏事，总有一天会结束</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_99"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_106" playOrder="106">
      <navLabel>
      <text>每个人都是值得尊敬的“作品”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_100"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_107" playOrder="107">
      <navLabel>
      <text>如何面对与重要的人分别</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_101"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_108" playOrder="108">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不要妄想将来</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_102"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_109" playOrder="109">
      <navLabel>
      <text>中国古典中的“失败学”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_103"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint id="np_110" playOrder="110">
      <navLabel>
      <text>不在意并非“不关心”</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="Text/part0008.xhtml#sigil_toc_id_104"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
  </navMap>
